method.source: the event seq of the first user message carrying the exact task prompt
method.shadow: a fold is a source loss only when its shadowedSeqs contains the source seq
method.residency: absent-by-shadow-range is exact; resident-at-end requires the source seq in surfaceTail; everything else is unknown
method.artifact: each path declared by a task check is searched verbatim in the user/checkpoint bytes; a tool listing does not count

limits: Only stage-B cells persist a session log; for other cells the exact surface at each fold is not replayed.
Exact prompt absence does not prove that no paraphrase was present; the artifact path and the checkpoint text are reported separately.
No task root was registered and no surface was pinned: this is a read-only audit of the recorded delivery.
